limitations: Static analysis does not establish runtime behavior or intent.
Pseudocode is Ghidra reconstruction, not original source code.
Details cover the first 16 internal functions or up to 8 explicitly selected entries; calls cover at most 64 instructions each.
Names and namespaces are limited to 256 characters; instruction bytes to 32 bytes.

References cover at most 64 listing instructions and 64 exact targets per selected function; body ranges retain at most 64 inclusive ranges. References to undefined memory, code or the interior of a data item are omitted, not reported as unresolved.
Memory blocks retain at most 64 blocks and 16 file-backed ranges per block; uninitialized or synthetic blocks have no file range.

Selected functions retain at most 128 basic blocks (8 flows each) and 128 call sites; counts stop at 4096 blocks and 65536 instructions. Unresolved indirect calls and computed jumps are reported without a target.
Pointer slots are at most 4 initialized data references to each function entry; thunk targets are Ghidra's own thunk resolution.
